mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates easy monetary conditions, which can stimulate borrowing and investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 20-day windows following low FEDFUNDS levels.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate suggests a weak labor market, which could reduce consumer spending and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the 60-day windows when UNRATE is above 8%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 30% of the 20-day windows following increased housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, combined with a decrease in GDP growth, suggests supply chain constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 40% of the 60-day windows when INDPRO increases and GDPC1 decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate in a tightening monetary cycle can lead to decreased borrowing and investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 30% of the 20-day windows when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in payroll employment suggests a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 20% of the 5-day windows following significant PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales, combined with high federal funds rates, suggests consumer strength despite tight monetary conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 60-day windows when RSAFS increases and FEDFUNDS is above 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production suggests a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 30% of the 20-day windows when INDPRO decreases.
